name: albino_death_S_v02

request.prompt: Create a NEW dedicated MYTHIC-BOSS-quality hand-painted dark fantasy isometric RPG animation source for ALBINO DEMON, matching the supplied exact existing project reference. The name does NOT mean recolor white: preserve its vivid deep RED muscular skin, TWO enormous black ridged swept-back horns, one snarling fanged head, yellow eyes, TWO arms TWO digitigrade clawed legs, dark gunmetal SPIKED shoulder plates/forearm bracers/shin guards, skull-shaped belt buckle with hanging iron chains, short dark loincloth, long thick red tail curled close. No wings, shield or extra arms. Anatomical RIGHT hand grips ONE enormous iron crescent AXE on a long wood shaft; anatomical LEFT clawed hand is empty. Preserve boss-specific armor, skull belt, axe proportions, both horns and limb identity in all figures. Original detailed painted sprites, NOT a recolored existing rig, no lava or fist-golem shape. Orthographic elevated camera at35degrees, SOUTH facing FRONT, anatomical RIGHT weapon arm is screenLEFT and LEFT empty hand screenRIGHT. Exactly THREE full separate complete character figures in a TWO-COLUMN TWO-ROW grid: phase0 TOP LEFT, phase1 TOP RIGHT, phase2 BOTTOM LEFT, BOTTOM RIGHT CELL EMPTY. Reading order left to right then down. Each entire figure must be SMALL, occupying less than FORTY PERCENT of each grid cell's height and sixty percent of its width. Add very broad transparent gutters and outer margins. KEEP THE BOTTOM RIGHT CELL COMPLETELY EMPTY. Square sprite sheet. Each entire figure small inside middle HALF of its own grid cell, wide transparent gutters, all horns/tail/axe/feet uncut. Phase0 DYING stagger: knees buckle onto one knee, face grimace and shoulders sag, right hand still grips heavy axe lowered diagonally to ground; LEFT empty hand braces against own knee, body clearly shorter than idle. Phase1 COLLAPSE: torso pitches onto one side, both knees bent and a shoulder near ground, horns fully visible, RIGHT hand still clutching axe shaft close along body so blade touches body's forearm/leg silhouette, LEFT hand limp; no floating weapon. Phase2 DEAD terminal: lying entirely on its side, heavy full body flattened at ground, eyes shut, arms slack, tail curled against hip, RIGHT hand still touching axe shaft alongside body, axe blade rests against armor/leg so the whole corpse is one connected silhouette. Preserve red flesh, black ridged twin horns, dark spikes/armor, skull belt/iron chains and one full axe. Not kneeling for final frame: a complete low horizontal corpse. No duplicate postures, no generic fade, no extra limbs, no dropped detached axe. Exactly ONE connected silhouette per phase, no ground/shadow/glow/dust/specks/text/grid; TRUE alpha0 transparentbackground.
